profile.summary: Vedanta Power Limited builds, owns, and operates a coal based thermal power plant in Punjab. Vedanta Power Limited was formerly known as Talwandi Sabo Power Limited and changed its name to Vedanta Power Limited in June 2026. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Mumbai, India.
